summary.title: Vim Awesome
summary.one_liner: A browsable directory of popular Vim plugins, each listed with a short description, for finding plugins to add to your Vim setup.
takeaways: Vim Awesome is a searchable catalog of Vim plugins, with keyboard navigation shortcuts shown on the page.
The page lists plugins such as fugitive.vim (Git wrapper), surround.vim, NERD tree, Syntastic, vim-gitgutter, and vim-airline.
Each entry gives the plugin name, author-linked identifier and a one-line description of what it does.
summary.summary: This is a directory page from Vim Awesome listing many Vim plugins, each with a one-line description. The page text shows entries for tools covering Git integration (fugitive.vim, vim-gitgutter), code navigation and finding (NERD tree, CtrlP), syntax checking (Syntastic, ALE), completion (YouCompleteMe), status lines (vim-airline), commenting (NERD Commenter, commentary.vim), and language support (vim-go). The text is mostly a listing with little detail beyond each plugin's short description, so it works best as a quick index of candidate plugins rather than a tutorial.
